systems.system: Proximity distribution campaign for national identity cards and NIU cards
systems.country_label: campagne de distribution de proximité des CNI et NIU
systems.owner: Pointe-Noire town hall, with the police's departmental data collection section supervising the NIU project
systems.tiers: Pointe-Noire, its six arrondissements and the urban community of Tchiamba-Nzassi, from 9 September 2025; 10,506 identity cards of 2016 to 2024 and 25,549 NIU cards of 2020 to 2024 uncollected

note: A campaign handing out identity and tax-number cards ahead of the electoral roll revision. Nothing on civil registration.
